blockers: capture.poll cannot resolve a vault PENDING: the mode guard refuses BO-09/BO-10 on a vault lot, so the job raises IllegalTransition forever and the seat stays CAPTURE_PENDING.

An unknown/timed-out vault or capture outcome dead-ends: no attempt or provider order is persisted and the reconciler never sweeps CAPTURING, so a buyer can be charged at PayPal while the order sits CAPTURING with no GET.
A create-time 403 marks the token DELETED and returns without BO-26, vacancy or refill, leaving a stuck seat.
majors: try_fund dedupe swallows authorization/capture events: the deadline timer owns try_fund:{lot} and ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING drops earlier ones, so the capture buffer never starts early.
finalize_close closes a lot while a capture is still PENDING; LS-11 requires the capture window over and the ledger balanced.
capture.poll records the order and ledger but never updates paypal_captures.status, so stored money state is false.
Refill during FUNDING creates an offer that BO-01/BO-03 cannot continue (they require CHECKOUT_OPEN).
Vault mode calls the provider's create-order before the mode guard refuses BO-01, turning a refusal into a 500.
order.authorize retries call the provider without taking the row lock, so I7 is not re-checked.
Buyer notices say PayPal places a hold, which is false in vault mode; the api.md/vault-charge conflict has no Q entry.
BO-24 payee and amount checks are self-referential: both values come from the order, not the provider result.
An approval/expiry race returns INTERNAL_ERROR because the status check happens before the lock and IllegalTransition has no API mapping.
